say.en: "Your bank KYC expires today, click here." Thousands of people lose money to messages like this every year. Let us learn to recognise and stop cyber crime. In this lesson: Identify types of cyber crime.
Apply cyber safety habits.

body.en: *Cyber crime* is any crime in which a computer or network is the target or the tool. Hacking is gaining unauthorised access to a system; ethical hackers do it with permission to improve security. Eavesdropping is secretly listening to private communication. Phishing uses fake emails or sites to steal details, leading to identity theft. Ransomware locks data and demands payment. Cyber trolling and cyber bullying harass people online.
body.kn: ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರ್ ಅಥವಾ ಜಾಲವನ್ನು ಗುರಿಯಾಗಿಸುವ ಅಥವಾ ಸಾಧನವಾಗಿ ಬಳಸುವ ಅಪರಾಧ ಸೈಬರ್ ಅಪರಾಧ. ಹ್ಯಾಕಿಂಗ್, ಗುಪ್ತವಾಗಿ ಕೇಳುವುದು, ಫಿಶಿಂಗ್ ಮತ್ತು ಗುರುತು ಕಳ್ಳತನ, ರ‍್ಯಾನ್ಸಮ್‌ವೇರ್, ಸೈಬರ್ ಟ್ರೋಲಿಂಗ್ ಮತ್ತು ಬೆದರಿಕೆ ಇದರ ಪ್ರಕಾರಗಳು.

title.en: On the board: How a phishing attack works

say.en: A criminal sends an e-mail that looks like it comes from your bank.
The link opens a fake website that looks exactly like the real one.
When you type your password there, it goes straight to the criminal.
Check the sender and the address bar. Real banks never ask for your password by e-mail.
A longer password with more kinds of characters takes far longer to guess.

narration.en: We follow a phishing attack step by step and then list the habits that keep us safe.

right.en: Someone breaks into a school server without permission
A stranger secretly listens to a private online call
A fake bank email asks you to "verify" your card number
A criminal uses your stolen details to open an account in your name
Your files are locked and money is demanded to unlock them
A student is repeatedly insulted and threatened in a group chat
Someone posts provoking comments just to start fights

explanation.en: Hacking is unauthorised access; eavesdropping is secret listening; phishing tricks you into giving details, which leads to identity theft; ransomware locks data for payment; bullying and trolling harass people online.
explanation.kn: ಹ್ಯಾಕಿಂಗ್ ಅನಧಿಕೃತ ಪ್ರವೇಶ; ಫಿಶಿಂಗ್ ವಿವರ ಕದಿಯುವ ಮೋಸ; ರ್ಯಾನ್ಸಮ್‌ವೇರ್ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ಲಾಕ್ ಮಾಡಿ ಹಣ ಕೇಳುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: Use strong, unique passwords and two-factor authentication. Keep the operating system and antivirus updated and take regular backups. Do not open unknown links or attachments; check for https before entering details. Log out and clear history on shared computers. Report *cyber crime* to the police or the national cyber crime portal.
